repo_model.summary: This repository is a RelBench prediction workspace whose root candidate loads a configured task, produces validation and test predictions, and writes NumPy artifacts for the Kapso evaluation harness. The current main.py is a shape-correct trivial baseline intended to be replaced with a real solution.

entrypoints.how_to_run: python main.py --debug for the fast contract check; python main.py for the full training run.
python kapso_datasets/check_predictions.py after prediction files have been written.

where_to_edit.role: Primary solution entrypoint; replace the trivial task-family baselines with data loading, feature construction, training, and prediction logic.
Reusable task-loading, prediction-saving, temporal-safety, and MAP@K helpers.
Read-only contract reference for run modes, prediction formats, data access, and validation behavior.
Immutable scoring and archiving pipeline; do not modify.

claims.statement: main.py obtains the dataset and task from RELBENCH_DATASET and RELBENCH_TASK using the RelBench API with downloads disabled, then determines validation and test row counts from the task tables.

evidence.description: Reads the dataset name from the environment.

claims.statement: The seeded baseline branches by task family: recommendation emits repeated ranked IDs, binary classification emits 0.5 probabilities, multiclass classification emits uniform class probabilities, and other tasks emit the median training target.

evidence.description: Loads training data for the fallback task family.

claims.statement: The starter helpers provide a TaskContext containing dataset, task, database, and train/validation/test tables, and load both dataset and task from the sanitized cache without downloading.

evidence.description: Builds the database with the configured timestamp cutoff.
Adds train, validation, and test tables to the context.

claims.statement: The grader runs main.py as an isolated child subprocess, receives predictions through KAPSO_RUN_DATA_DIR, validates and scores validation predictions with the official task evaluator, and emits a machine-readable manifest.

evidence.description: Constructs the candidate command and debug mode.
Passes the run output directory to the child.

claims.statement: Full-fidelity runs are archived with prediction files, validation metrics, selection metadata, and a snapshot of candidate code; fast runs are not archived as results.

evidence.description: Copies validation and test prediction artifacts.

claims.statement: Every normal candidate run must write val_predictions.npy and test_predictions.npy with rows positionally aligned to the validation and test task tables; validation predictions must be out-of-sample with respect to validation labels.

evidence.description: Requires both files after every run and positional row alignment.
Requires validation predictions to come from a model that did not see validation labels.
Uses KAPSO_RUN_DATA_DIR as the output location.
Writes validation predictions in the normal path.

claims.statement: Required output formats are binary float probabilities of shape (N,) in [0,1], regression floats of shape (N,), multiclass floats of shape (N,C), and recommendation integer rankings of shape (N,K) containing distinct destination IDs in range.

evidence.description: Defines binary and regression prediction shapes and binary probability bounds.
Defines multiclass and recommendation output requirements.

claims.statement: The official search score is the primary validation metric computed by the grader; test metrics are unavailable inside this repository's sanitized evaluation loop.

evidence.description: Identifies the official validation primary metric as the search score.
States that test metrics are private.
Places the selected primary validation metric in the manifest score.

claims.statement: RelBench data access must use the sanitized read-only cache and download=False; test labels must not be probed because they are physically absent.

evidence.description: Requires download=False and prohibits probing for test labels.

claims.statement: The fast evaluation mode runs main.py with --debug while still scoring the complete official validation split, making it the intended end-to-end sanity check.

evidence.description: Specifies the debug command and its pipeline-validation purpose.
States that the scored item set never shrinks.

claims.statement: After writing predictions, the local checker validates file existence, shapes, finite values, binary bounds, and recommendation dtype, and prints an all-checks-passed message on success.

evidence.description: Recommends running the prediction checker before harness scoring.
Fails when a prediction file is missing.

claims.statement: In rolling-harness snapshots, an absent val.parquet means the current tick has no validation table; main.py intentionally skips val_predictions.npy for that tick and writes only test predictions, which the grader later assembles into official vectors.

evidence.description: Documents the empty validation-table rolling behavior.
Sets validation row count to zero when val.parquet is absent.
Detects rolling mode from the empty validation count.
Skips validation output in rolling mode.
Defines one candidate invocation per rolling tick.
Requires test predictions for each rolling tick.

claims.statement: The current baseline does not make --debug computationally cheaper: it only reports whether the flag appeared in argv, while the prediction branches are otherwise identical.

evidence.description: Uses --debug only for the diagnostic value in the message.
Shows that fast mode differs by adding --debug to the command.

claims.statement: The local checker warns rather than failing when recommendation IDs are out of range or duplicate, even though the evaluation contract requires in-range distinct ranked IDs; models should enforce those conditions themselves.

evidence.description: Requires ranked distinct destination IDs in range.
Reports out-of-range IDs as a warning.

claims.statement: The evaluation suite must not be modified or reimplemented in candidate code; it is intended to remain an immutable delegating scorer, and files under kapso_evaluation are explicitly excluded from candidate changes.

evidence.description: Describes grader.py as the complete immutable scoring pipeline.
Says not to reimplement the evaluation pipeline.

claims.statement: The candidate directly depends on NumPy and RelBench task APIs, including RecommendationTask, TaskType, and get_task.

evidence.description: Imports RelBench task classes and task loader.
Imports RelBench dataset and task loaders.

claims.statement: Runtime configuration is supplied through environment variables, notably dataset/task identity, sanitized cache location, run output directory, timeouts, primary metric, and work/cache roots.

evidence.description: Lists dataset and task environment variables.
Lists the primary metric and work directory.

claims.statement: The evaluation suite requires only Python with relbench and numpy installed and is expected to operate against the pre-sanitized cache rather than downloading data.

evidence.description: States the Python, relbench, and numpy setup requirement.
Recommends a fast dry run for verification.

book.summary: This repository is a RelBench prediction workspace whose root candidate loads a configured task, produces validation and test predictions, and writes NumPy artifacts for the Kapso evaluation harness. The current main.py is a shape-correct trivial baseline intended to be replaced with a real solution.

toc.one_liner: A root candidate generates task-family-specific predictions that an isolated grader validates and scores.

toc.title: Testing
toc.one_liner: Use debug evaluation and the prediction checker before a full run.

toc.title: Gotchas
toc.one_liner: Rolling snapshots, debug semantics, and warning-only checks can differ from the normal contract path.

toc.title: Dependencies
toc.one_liner: The candidate relies on Python, NumPy, and the RelBench package with handler-provided environment configuration.
